description: Reminds Claude to end a long reply with the human:tldr block, in the skill's locked format.

hooks.command:
printf %s 'When a reply runs past ~12 lines or ~150 words and is not mostly code, files or a table, end it with the human:tldr block, copied exactly, as the last thing in the reply:

> **TL;DR**
> ```
> Two or three plain sentences, under 50 words, no formatting marks inside.
> ```

All four lines start with a greater-than sign and a space. Applies for the whole session.
'
